SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25000880
DOCKET NO. F991823
PLAINTIFF – ATHENE ANNUITY AND LIFE COMPANY
DEFENDANTS- 313-315 S. 11TH LLC, ET. AL
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 7th DAY OF July 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of NEWARK, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY, CHANCERY DIVISION, ESSEX COUNTY, DOCKET NO. F991823
ATHENE ANNUITY AND LIFE COMPANY
Plaintiff
-vs-
313-315 S. 11TH LLC, ET. AL
Defendants
Execution for Sale of Mortgaged Premises
By virtue of the above stated writ of Execution, to me directed, I shall expose for sale by Public Auction in SHERIFF'S OFFICE, Essex County Courts Building in Newark, on Tuesday, July 7, 2026, at one-thirty P.M. (Prevailing Time)
Commonly known as:
313-315 SOUTH 11TH STREET NEWARK, NJ 07103
LOT NO. 27 IN BLOCK NO. 1795
DIMENSION OF LOT APPROXIMATELY: 56 X 100
NEAREST CROSS STREET: THIRTEENTH AVENUE
GOOD FAITH ESTIMATE O UPSET PRICE: $854,938.41. THE OCCUPANCY STATUS OF THE PROPERTY BEING FORECLOSED HEREIN IS PRESENTLY UNKNOWN. THIS IS A COMMERCIAL PROPERTY. BEGINNING AT A POINT ON THE WESTERLY SIDE OF SO. ELEVENTH STREET DISTANT NORTHERLY 138.00 FEET FROM THE INTERSECTION OF THE NORTHERLY SIDE OF THIRTEENTH AVENUE WITH THE WESTERLY LINE OF SOUTH ELEVENTH STRRET THENCE PRIOR LIENS/ ENCUMBRANCES $6,949.52. WATER OPEN PLUS PENALTY - TOTAL AS OF MARCH 3, 2025: $6,949.52
A full legal description can be found in the office of the Register of Essex County.
A DEPOSIT OF 20% OF THE BID PRICE IN CERTIFIED FUNDS IS REQUIRED AT THE TIME OF SALE.
SURPLUS MONEY: IF AFTER THE SALE AND SATISFACTION OF THE MORTGAGE DEBT, INCLUDING COSTS AND EXPENSES, THERE REMAINS ANY SURPLUS MONEY, THE MONEY WILL BE DEPOSITED INTO THE SUPERIOR COURT TRUST FUND AND ANY PERSON CLAIMING THE SURPLUS, OR ANY PART THEREOF, MAY FILE A MOTION PURSUANT TO COURT RULES 4:64-3 AND 4:57-2 STATING THE NATURE AND EXTENT OF THAT PERSON’S CLAIM AND ASKING FOR AN ORDER DIRECTING PAYMENT OF THE SURPLUS MONEY. THE SHERIFF OR OTHER PERSON CONDUCTING THE SALE WILL HAVE INFORMATION REGARDING THE SURPLUS, IF ANY.
The approximate amount of the Judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $845,302.96, together with the costs of this sale. The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale from time to time as provided by Law
Newark, N.J. June 16, 2026
AMIR D. JONES, Sheriff
FEIN SUCH KAHN & SHEPARD, P.C., ATTORNEY(S)
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
313-315 SOUTH 11TH STREET NEWARK, NJ 07103
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $720,280.90 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: June 16, 2026
FEIN SUCH KAHN & SHEPARD, P.C.
6 CAMPUS DRIVE
SUITE 304
PARSIPPANY, NJ 07054
973-538-4700
